threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Why is your tier. I wrote it from your messages (quality over quantity, no Spec Kit, one light artifact). Rewrite it in your words or tell me it stands. An agent-written Why defeats the point.

Anchor.selected_text: Plans here help neither reader: the human approved four times for one small plan, and the agent still shipped holes. The repo is drifting toward Spec Kit, with many documents per feature and a review for each. The goal is quality over quantity. One light artifact the human reads in minutes, the agent can run with, and both keep current.

Replies.Author: rcliao
Replies.Text: approved on this why and okay to keep it; how I would phrase it: comments is becoming a dedicated planning tool but it's getting more complicated to plan with little benefit (e.g. spend 1 hour to plan for 1 hour of work that it may be easier for agnet to run and build and iterate); I want to explore a way to simplify comments as lightweight plan to align then to build autonomously after (kind of planning and sync with the team and then get to build);
